sections.p: Visito is an online booking and client management service for beauty salons and dental clinics in Georgia. Operator details (company name, address, identification number) will be added here.

Each salon or clinic decides what it stores about its clients and why — it is the data controller. Visito processes that data only on the business's behalf, as a data processor. For the accounts of business owners and their teams, Visito itself is the controller.

Accounts: name, email, language. Clients of a business: name, phone, optional email and birthday, notes, booking history, payments, marketing consents with date and source. Clients who book online also give a comment if they wish. Dental clinics may keep treatment notes — health data that only the clinic's doctors and owner can open, and every opening is logged.

In the European Union: the database is hosted by Supabase in Frankfurt (Germany); the application runs on Netlify. Text messages and emails are sent through providers listed in the data processing agreement.
Booking confirmations and reminders are service messages. Promotions are sent only with separate, recorded consent and always contain an unsubscribe link.
Data is kept while the business uses Visito. When a business deletes its account, everything is removed after 14 days. A business can delete a single client's personal data at any time.

You can ask the salon or clinic for a copy of your data, a correction or deletion, and you can withdraw marketing consent at any time with the link in any promotional message. Businesses can export or delete a client's data in Visito in one step.
Strict separation between businesses in the database, encrypted connections, access by role, and an audit log of sensitive actions.
Contact details for privacy questions will be added here.
Visito provides online booking, a calendar, client records, SMS reminders and reports to salons and clinics ("businesses").
New businesses start with a 14-day free trial. Plans, prices and included SMS are shown before payment and may change with notice.
The business is responsible for the client data it enters, for having a lawful reason to process it, and for clients' consent to promotional messages.
No spam, no unlawful content, no attempts to access other businesses' data or to disrupt the service.
We aim for high availability and back up data, but cannot promise uninterrupted service.
A business can export its data and delete its account at any time; data is removed 14 days later. We may suspend accounts for unpaid invoices or misuse; data stays available for export.
Limitation of liability, dispute resolution and governing law (Georgia) will be set out here by our lawyer.
The business (controller) instructs Visito (processor) to process its clients' personal data to provide the service.
Bookings, reminders, client records, payments records and reports, for as long as the business uses Visito.
Contact data, booking and payment history, consents, notes; for dental clinics, treatment notes (health data, special category).

Supabase (database, EU — Frankfurt), Netlify (hosting), Resend (email), an SMS provider in Georgia (to be named), Sentry (error reports, without client data). The business is informed before new sub-processors are added.
Row-level separation of businesses, encryption in transit and at rest, role-based access, logging of sensitive actions, regular backups.
Visito informs the business without undue delay after becoming aware of a breach.
The business can export all data at any time; on deletion, data is erased after 14 days, including from active systems.

card.q: Do I need a card for the trial?
card.a: No. Sign up with your email; the 14 days start right away.

phone.q: Does it work on a phone?
phone.a: Yes. Visito works in any browser and can be added to the home screen of an iPhone or Android phone like an app.

sms.q: How do the SMS reminders work?
sms.a: Visito sends reminders automatically before each visit, in your salon's language and with its name. Every plan includes SMS each month.

data.a: Each business is strictly separated, the data is encrypted and kept on servers in the EU. You can download or delete it at any time.

switch.q: Can I move from my current program?
switch.a: Yes. Import your clients, price list and future bookings from Excel or CSV — nobody gets an SMS during the import.

dental.q: Is it suitable for a dental clinic?
dental.a: Yes. Book by chair or room, plan longer visits, and keep treatment notes that only doctors and the owner can read.

final.text: 14 days free. Set up in an evening; your clients book tomorrow.
